svg.title: A concrete Unsloth run trains a 4B function-calling adapter from one dataset and one base model.
svg.desc: The glaive-function-calling-v2 dataset (113K examples) and a 4-bit-quantized Nemotron-Nano-4B-v1.1 base feed an SFT run with rank-16 LoRA adapters (alpha 32, max sequence length 4096, packing enabled), producing a versioned function-calling adapter evaluated before deployment.
